records.title: Proportion Of Persons Aged 15 Years And Above Who Feel Safe Walking Alone In Their Neighbourhood At Night, Annual
records.footnote: Data are from Gallup's global law and order report. Data for 2020 is not available due to covid restrictions, and Gallup uses telephone or face-to-face surveys to obtain its data. Data are used for SDG 16.1.4 'Proportion of population that feel safe walking alone around the area they live after dark'. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 16.1.4.
